_comment: This is the ONLY mutable file in an Inbox entry. End-Session writes it once with state 'pending' and never touches it again, including on re-runs. Knowledge-Promoter owns it thereafter. Valid states: pending | in_review | promoted | partially_promoted | rejected | superseded. After review, candidate_outcomes holds one record per candidate id, e.g. { "id": "cand-001", "outcome": "promoted", "destination": "AI-Memory/02_Learnings/asr-code-switching.md" }.
